features.title: Voronoi build (Delaunay, merge, distributed builder)
features.description: Host loops of the Delaunay cell builder, the merge and the DistributedBuilder (HostParallelFor): the Kokkos host thread pool in Kokkos builds, serial otherwise.

subfeatures.title: Thread subdomains
subfeatures.description: Splits each rank's domain into subdomains built concurrently on host threads, one serial geometry per subdomain. Host threads only, even in device builds.

subfeatures.title: Geometry (volumes, centroids, faces, clipping)
subfeatures.description: KokkosGeometryExecutor on the device in device builds, HostGeometryExecutor otherwise (or with --voronoi-on-host).

rules.message: Thread subdomains build their geometry serially on the host even in device builds; consider the geometry on the host (docs/madvoro_thread_subdomains_mpi.md, section 4.6).
